targets.review_note: Original operators separate independent digit blocks. A nonnegative block is maximized by retaining its entire decimal numeral. A negative block is maximized by keeping only its first digit negative and making the remaining suffix positive; any longer negative prefix both increases the subtraction and reduces the remaining positive suffix. Leading zeroes in that suffix must be split into individual +0 terms to obey the original validity rule. Existing signs and all original digits are preserved, including an initial explicit plus or minus.
